title: Auditing Reciprocal Sentiment Alignment: Inversion Risk, Dialect Representation and Intent Misalignment in Transformers

bias_targets.methodology: Measuring sentiment alignment divergence, directional bias, and polarity inversion rates across parallel Bengali and English sentence pairs to identify cross-lingual intent misalignment.
Comparing cross-lingual sentiment alignment errors between formal (Sadhu) and colloquial (Cholito) Bengali linguistic registers to quantify a 'Dialect Gap' and 'Modern Bias'.
